question_text: Explain how a virtual database view can simplify access to selected data without storing a separate copy of every displayed result.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: The view stores a query definition. Users query it as a table while the DBMS derives rows from underlying tables. It can hide joins/unneeded fields and reflect changes in base data.
